meta.plant_name: QTS Cedar Rapids data center power station

units.notes: I checked the Linn County air permit collection for QTS Cedar Rapids I, LLC at 4814 76th Avenue SW in Fairfax, issued October 1, 2025. It lists 74 Caterpillar 3516C engines and 14 Caterpillar D1250 GC engines, 88 in all. That agrees with GEM's engine counts. The permits give horsepower only, so the megawatt figures still rest on the sources GEM already has.
